title: St Jude 2026
summary: Our fourth year fundraising for St Jude
content:
tl;dr:

Cancer is bad, St Jude is good, donate here

Adam and I are once again raising money for St Jude as part of Relay's annual fundraising event.

As always, we have stickers — a two pack this year. A Ruminate Game Boy one that I lovingly drew some food creatures for and a All Meat No Proxy sticker. A $20 donation gets you both stickers (and any others we might add over the month which usually happens).

I'll be offering drawings again, which were very popular last year. An animal, vehicle, whatever you fancy really - I'll give it a good go even if it makes me tear my hair out like a Routemaster bus did last year. Check out last years drawings to get an idea of what you'll get. You could even ask for a custom Jeff, who doesn't look anything like a penis, if you want.

Adam has assigned himself a harder task of making omg.lol friendship bracelets for $50. Dibs on the first one.

We'll also have some other rewards and fun things from other people in the extended omg.lol universe so keep an eye out for those.

And because I'm pretty sure Stephen likes to make me work hard, Donation Daddy had to be updated to support the new bandana reward, Spaghetty font from SimpleBits to match the cowboy theme, and the new campaigns and reward art.

Anything you can donate no matter how small is worthwhile and if you're not in a position to donate, share the link instead.

Donate here and let's end childhood cancer.
